summary: The Dimensional Collapse dungeon lies at the deepest core of Rift‑Heart. Temporal fractures, void storms, and Discord corruption converge here, creating a lethal nexus of instability. The Rift Prime rules this dungeon as a living embodiment of collapse.
history: Formed when Rift‑Heart collapsed inward during the First Fracture.
Temporal instability spread outward, creating loops and echoes.
Void breaches opened, linking Discord to the cosmic emptiness.
Discord energy condensed into lethal storms.
The Rift Prime manifested as the nexus of collapse.
